subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): generic outbound delivery-report seam; WhatsApp native auto-reply reports provider-accepted sends

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw/plugin-sdk/outbound-delivery-report` as the public contract for plugin self-delivered outbound sends?
rationale: The diff promotes a new public Plugin SDK subpath and idempotency contract, which becomes compatibility-sensitive once released and cannot be safely decided by automation alone.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Keep the current seam shape, require redacted WhatsApp/runtime proof, and merge once the maintainer API decision is explicit.

options.title: Reshape before release
options.body: Rename or narrow the seam and idempotency contract before it becomes public plugin API.

options.title: Pause as design work
options.body: Keep #97726 open as the design point and pause or close this PR until the public contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the current seam shape, require redacted WhatsApp/runtime proof, and merge once the maintainer API decision is explicit.
